definition.text: Obstructed defecation syndrome (ODS) is a functional pooping disorder. People with ODS have trouble evacuating their bowels, resulting in constipation. It may be for a variety of reasons, both mechanical and psychological. Treatment is usually conservative and holistic, but sometimes surgery is needed.
